name: Cludo
description: Crawler for Cludo's hosted site-search product. It scans the domains a customer configures, follows links and sitemap URLs, and extracts page content and metadata into that customer's search index. Cludo documents that site owners can steer it with robots.txt rules addressed to the cludo token, and publishes the two proxy addresses — one per cluster, EU and US — that all of its services, crawlers included, make outbound requests from.
